assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original visual-novel full-body character expression atlas for the adult 25-year-old male first-person player character in Before the Rain Stops, not a portrait of the actual user. Chinese adult man, short slightly wavy dark brown hair, gray-brown eyes, a reserved ordinary adult face and slender realistic adult proportions. Modest unbranded slate-gray lightweight rain jacket over an ivory shirt, dark navy straight trousers, plain charcoal walking shoes, a small empty beige cloth tote held in his left hand. Quiet clean hand-drawn Chinese/Japanese indie visual-novel linework and restrained cool rain-night colors matching the supplied heroine's rendering style, but do not copy her face, hair clip, skirt or female identity. The second reference supplies layout only. ONE 3-column by 2-row expression atlas with exactly SIX separate, equal-sized, SMALL full-body standing figures of the SAME person in exactly the same pose/outfit/scale. All head, hands, legs and both complete shoes visible. Top row neutral, smile, surprised; bottom row worried, quietly hurt/disappointed, slightly shy with eyes open. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, figures no taller than about 420px, large empty transparent gutter about 85px between the rows and 45px outer margins. No body touches a canvas edge. Match the clear full-body layout of the second reference only; never copy that person's identity or clothing. True transparent RGBA everywhere behind the figures; no floor, glow, cast shadow, gradient, frame, grid, labels or text.
